stages.headline: Pupils can line up in fives or in sixes. What is the least number of pupils if there are more than 30?
stages.headlineEnglish: Pupils can line up in fives or in sixes. What is the least number of pupils if there are more than 30?
stages.problemText: Pupils can line up in fives or in sixes. What is the least number of pupils if there are more than 30?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. LCM(5, 6) = 30. 2. Multiples 30, 60. 3. The first above 30 is 60.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. LCM(5, 6) = 30. 2. Multiples 30, 60. 3. The first above 30 is 60.
